stem_en: Common risks and red flags associated with trade finance clients may include: (Choose four.)

options_en.A: Account activity that is not consistent with the purpose of the account
options_en.B: Bills of lading matching the description of goods, quantities, and values, with transshipment details justified
options_en.C: Transaction structures that appear unnecessarily complex
options_en.D: Trade documents, such as invoices and letters of credit, that are not clearly worded or are in foreign languages
options_en.E: Invoices with prices that are much higher than market price
